selection: Mean final-step success across seeds 0/1 and the last 10 pre-final evaluations (950K..995K); ties: new final success, success AUC, proximity to author defaults. Final 100-episode evaluation excluded from tuning.
selection_seed_overlap: Rerun seeds 0/1 overlap tuning seeds; not independent validation.
followup_parameters: Transfer PickAndPlace-selected MFPO hyperparameters unchanged; no additional sweeps.
common_settings: All other original HER batch256 settings and pinned vendor implementation unchanged.
other_methods: Adopt running host2 PIDs and preserve frozen sources/commands; host1 unchanged.
previous_mfpo: Preserve checkpoints and evaluations; stop default MFPO runs and supersede its follow-up queue only after GPU preflights pass.
failure_policy: Block affected method chain; no automatic hidden changes or seed substitution.
validation: Pinned upstream vendor hashes unchanged; scheduler selection/gating and dashboard cohort aggregation checked locally. GPU preflights execute four real updates for each of the nine settings before handoff.
